newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 26.

text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:

-- Companies surveyed by the financial daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said capital investment by the private sector in the business year starting on April 1 is expected to increase a moderate 0.1 percent from the current year.
-- Ruling parties plan to lift a ban on holding companies as early as next January.

-- Government to submit bill to parliament aimed at banning firms and individuals from giving bribes to politicians and officials overseas to correct custom of secrecy in international commercial dealings.
-- LIMA: Sixth round of preliminary talks on hostage crisis to begin in Lima on February 25.
-- Administrative Reform Council to review long-term plans on welfare and land development.
-- Bill worked out to allow Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp to start international phone business.
